title: Business-case / value strength

questions.text: Is there a concrete reason the buyer should care enough to move?

inputs: the customer's stated pain and goals

criteria.guide: Is the pain stated by the customer, not assumed?
Is the outcome the customer wants stated?

criteria.text: metrics / value are present where possible
criteria.guide: Are value figures the customer's own numbers, not inflated or invented?

har97.text: * metrics / value are present where possible

criteria.text: action connects to the customer’s stated problem
criteria.guide: Does the action address the problem the customer stated?

har97.text: * action connects to the customer’s stated problem

criteria.text: agent is not advancing the process on generic best practice alone
criteria.guide: Is the push justified by this customer's case, not by a generic playbook step?

har97.text: * agent is not advancing the process on generic best practice alone

diagnostics.name: weak_business_case
diagnostics.when: pain, outcome or value is missing, generic or inflated
